title: PowerShell live-remote line parser
failure_signature: An inline PowerShell split expression treated command output as a collection expression and reduced the live remote hash to one character.
trigger_preconditions: git ls-remote output is embedded directly in a parenthesized split expression.
PowerShell collection and operator precedence is not made explicit.
candidate_workaround: Capture exactly one ls-remote output line first, then split that scalar line on whitespace and require a forty-hex-character hash.
recurrence_guard: Validate live hash length and hexadecimal form before comparing it with local, upstream, and tracking heads.
rollback: Discard the malformed one-character value and make no remote-equality claim from it.
scope_boundary: Read-only Git remote parsing only; no repository or remote mutation.
